queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Grammarly for Windows' AND publisher = 'Grammarly Inc.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Grammarly for Windows' AND publisher = 'Grammarly Inc.' AND version_compare(version, '1.2.304.1976') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'grammarly desktop.exe');
